credit: U.S. Geological Survey, 3DEP OPR DEM, NM_SouthEast_2018_D19
method: Extract a 401 by 401 native 1 m bare-earth grid from the USGS source GeoTIFF around the Discovery candidate center. Source float elevations are rounded to 1 cm for compact publication; this is not a vertical accuracy claim. WGS84 candidate coordinates are projected with UTM formulas without a NAD83(2011) datum shift.
caveats: This 400 m local patch is only a small part of the 2400 m Discovery window.
Bare-earth processing may omit rocks, vegetation and other objects above ground.
One-meter samples may miss sub-meter obstacles, cracks and wheel traps.
The exact survey accuracy and independent obstacle labels are not attached.
Terrain-break screens derived from this DEM are not rover clearance or a field-verified trail.
